notes: CDRH device letter for the Sea-Long Medical Treatment Hood (hyperbaric-chamber accessory): extensive 21 CFR 820 Quality System Regulation (CGMP) violations (complaint handling, process validation, CAPA, DMR/DHR, audits, management review), plus adulteration (501(h) QSR nonconformance and 501(f)(1)(B) lack of PMA for new intended uses such as NIV/ARDS/COVID-19 treatment) and misbranding (502(o) no new 510(k), 502(c)/502(t)(2) UDI/GUDID failures). No organisms, sterility, or contamination are involved (non-sterile device).
